mcp_server.name: ghost-detection-mcp
mcp_server.description: Snowflake-managed MCP server for Ghost Detection System

tools.name: ghost-search
tools.description: Semantic search for ghost data by name, type, description, behavior, location, and threat level
use_cases: Search by location or threat level

tools.name: ghost-analytics
tools.description: Natural language interface for analytical queries about ghosts, sightings, and patterns
example_queries: What are the top 5 most active ghosts this month?
Show me sighting trends by location over the last 6 months
Which ghost types have the highest threat levels?
Calculate average EMF readings by ghost type

tools.name: sighting-search
tools.description: Search ghost sighting events by location, date, witnesses, and activity levels
use_cases: Filter by activity levels or EMF readings

tools.name: evidence-search
tools.description: Search evidence repository including images, audio, video, and sensor data

arguments.message: Show me ghost activity trends by month

setup_steps: 3. Copy client_id and client_secret to this config
4. Replace <YOUR_ACCOUNT> with your Snowflake account identifier
5. Configure your MCP client with these settings

troubleshooting.invalid_consent_request: Change OAuth scope from 'session:role:all' to 'session:role:GHOSTBUSTER' in the authorization URL
troubleshooting.tool_not_found: Verify Cortex Search services exist: SHOW CORTEX SEARCH SERVICES;
troubleshooting.insufficient_privileges: Grant USAGE on MCP server and Cortex services to your role

monitoring.show_servers: SHOW MCP SERVERS IN SCHEMA APP;
monitoring.audit_logs: SELECT * FROM AUDIT_LOG WHERE table_name = 'MCP_SERVER' ORDER BY operation_datetime DESC;

python_client_example.description: Example Python client using requests library
